cards.ex: We need to iron out our differences before we can move forward with the project.
cards.exUz: Loyiha bilan oldinga siljishimizdan oldin kelishmovchiliklarimizni bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchiliklarni muzokara yo'li bilan hal qilish, muammolarni yechish.

cards.ex: I'm willing to meet you halfway on the price if you can deliver it sooner.
cards.exUz: Agar siz uni tezroq yetkazib bera olsangiz, narx bo'yicha yarim yo'lda uchrashishga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Bir kelishuvga erishish uchun har ikki tomon ham o'z talablaridan voz kechishi.

cards.ex: They finally settled the dispute over the property line.
cards.exUz: Ular nihoyat mulk chegarasi bo'yicha bahsni hal qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror bahsni yoki kelishmovchilikni yechimini topish, yakunlash.

cards.ex: It wasn't ideal, but we reached a compromise that everyone could live with.
cards.exUz: Bu ideal emas edi, lekin biz hamma qabul qila oladigan kelishuvga erishdik.
cards.uzDef: Har ikki tomon manfaatlarini qondiradigan kelishuvni topish.

cards.ex: After years of feuding, the two families finally decided to bury the hatchet.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik adovatdan so'ng, ikki oila nihoyat urushni unutishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi adovatlarni unutib, munosabatlarni tiklash.

cards.ex: Let's take a cooling-off period before we discuss this again tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertaga bu haqda yana muhokama qilishdan oldin, keling, sovutish davrini olaylik.
cards.uzDef: Bahs-munozaralardan keyin his-tuyg'ularni tinchlantirish uchun ajratilgan vaqt.

cards.ex: The inheritance money was a major bone of contention between the siblings.
cards.exUz: Meros pul opa-singillar o'rtasida asosiy tortishuv sababi edi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda tortishuvga sabab bo'ladigan masala.

cards.ex: He tried to smooth things over by apologizing for his behavior.
cards.exUz: U o'z xatti-harakatlari uchun kechirim so'rab, vaziyatni yumshatishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Noqulay vaziyatni yaxshilash, xatolarni tuzatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: There was a real clash of opinions during the meeting about the new marketing strategy.
cards.exUz: Yangi marketing strategiyasi haqidagi yig'ilishda haqiqiy fikrlar to'qnashuvi yuz berdi.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlar bir-biriga zid bo'lganda yuzaga keladigan kelishmovchilik.

cards.ex: They left the company on bad terms after a disagreement with the boss.
cards.exUz: Ular boshliq bilan kelishmovchilikdan keyin kompaniyani yomon munosabatlarda tark etishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishi bilan do'stona bo'lmagan, yomon munosabatlarda bo'lish.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets out of control.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni nazoratdan chiqib ketmasidan oldin yo'q qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo kuchayib ketmasidan oldin uni darhol hal qilish.

cards.ex: He brought flowers as a peace offering after their argument.
cards.exUz: U janjaldan keyin tinchlik taklifi sifatida gullar olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilikdan keyin munosabatlarni tiklash uchun qilingan taklif yoki sovg'a.

cards.ex: Neither side was willing to back down, so the negotiation reached a stalemate.
cards.exUz: Hech bir tomon chekinishni xohlamadi, shuning uchun muzokaralar to'xtab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Bahsda yoki tortishuvda o'z fikridan voz kechish.

cards.ex: Even though everyone disagreed with her, she stood her ground.
cards.exUz: Hamma unga qarshi bo'lsa ham, u o'z fikrida qoldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni himoya qilish, bosimga qaramay o'z pozitsiyangizda qolish.

cards.ex: We'll just have to agree to disagree about politics.
cards.exUz: Biz siyosat haqida kelisha olmaslikka kelishishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Farqli fikrlarga ega bo'lishni qabul qilish va bahsni davom ettirmaslik.

cards.ex: It's time to let bygones be bygones and move on with our lives.
cards.exUz: Endi o'tmishni unutib, hayotimizni davom ettirish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi voqealarni unutib, oldinga intilish.

cards.ex: The debate quickly turned into a war of words between the two candidates.
cards.exUz: Debatlar tezda ikki nomzod o'rtasida so'z jangiga aylanib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq, jiddiy tortishuv, ko'pincha ommaviy axborot vositalarida.

cards.ex: The project failed due to a breakdown in communication between the team members.
cards.exUz: Loyiha jamoa a'zolari o'rtasidagi aloqa uzilishi tufayli muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar o'rtasida aloqa yo'qligi, tushunmovchiliklar mavjudligi.

cards.ex: Mediation can help couples resolve their differences in a constructive way.
cards.exUz: Vositalashuv juftliklarga o'z farqlarini konstruktiv tarzda hal qilishga yordam berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchiliklarni bartaraf etish, yechim topish.

cards.ex: They had a big fight, but they're trying to patch things up now.
cards.exUz: Ularning katta janjali bor edi, lekin ular hozir munosabatlarni tiklashga harakat qilishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Janjaldan keyin munosabatlarni yaxshilashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Let's call a truce and try to find a solution together.
cards.exUz: Keling, sulh e'lon qilamiz va birgalikda yechim topishga harakat qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtinchalik kelishuv, janjalni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: We're hoping to find a compromise solution that works for everyone.
cards.exUz: Biz hamma uchun mos keladigan kelishuv yechimini topishga umid qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Har ikki tomon manfaatlarini qondiradigan yechim.

cards.ex: I needed to get it off my chest, so I told him how I really felt.
cards.exUz: Men buni aytishim kerak edi, shuning uchun unga o'zimni qanday his qilayotganimni aytdim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida gapirib, o'zingizni yengil his qilish.

cards.ex: I wanted to argue, but I had to bite my tongue.
cards.exUz: Men bahslashmoqchi edim, lekin tilingni tiyishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir demoqchi bo'lsangiz ham, o'zingizni tiyish.

cards.ex: We need to clear the air after that misunderstanding.
cards.exUz: O'sha tushunmovchilikdan keyin vaziyatni aniqlashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tushunmovchiliklarni yo'qotish uchun bahslashish yoki gaplashish.

cards.ex: I've drawn a line in the sand – I won't tolerate that kind of behavior anymore.
cards.exUz: Men chegara belgiladim - bunday xatti-harakatlarga endi toqat qilmayman.
cards.term: draw a line in the sand
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan xatti-harakatlar uchun aniq chegara belgilash.

cards.ex: She tried to pour oil on troubled waters by suggesting a compromise.
cards.exUz: U kelishuvni taklif qilib, vaziyatni yumshatishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Janjalni yoki qiyin vaziyatni tinchlantirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The salary was the main sticking point in the negotiations.
cards.exUz: Maosh muzokaralardagi asosiy bahsli nuqta edi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuvga erishishga to'sqinlik qiladigan masala.

cards.ex: Give him a few minutes to simmer down before you talk to him.
cards.exUz: U bilan gaplashishdan oldin unga bir necha daqiqa tinchlanishiga ruxsat bering.
cards.uzDef: G'azab yoki hayajonni kamaytirish.

cards.ex: They're always quarreling over who gets to use the TV remote.
cards.exUz: Ular doimo televizor pultini kim ishlatishi kerakligi haqida janjallashadilar.
cards.uzDef: Unchalik muhim bo'lmagan narsa uchun bahslashish.
